Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full consultation-scheduler payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Book your free consultation","attorneyName":"Marcus Vale","attorneyTitle":"Managing Partner - Personal Injury","attorneyPhoto":"lawyer-1","modes":[{"id":"in_person","label":"In person","icon":"in_person"},{"id":"phone","label":"Phone","icon":"phone"},{"id":"video","label":"Video","icon":"video"}],"days":[{"id":"mon","label":"Mon","sublabel":"Sep 21","slots":[{"id":"m1","label":"9:00 AM"},{"id":"m2","label":"11:30 AM"},{"id":"m3","label":"2:00 PM"}]},{"id":"tue","label":"Tue","sublabel":"Sep 22","slots":[{"id":"t1","label":"10:00 AM"},{"id":"t2","label":"1:00 PM","disabled":true},{"id":"t3","label":"3:30 PM"}]},{"id":"wed","label":"Wed","sublabel":"Sep 23","slots":[{"id":"w1","label":"9:30 AM"},{"id":"w2","label":"12:00 PM"},{"id":"w3","label":"4:00 PM"}]},{"id":"thu","label":"Thu","sublabel":"Sep 24","slots":[{"id":"h1","label":"11:00 AM"},{"id":"h2","label":"2:30 PM"}]},{"id":"fri","label":"Fri","sublabel":"Sep 25","slots":[{"id":"f1","label":"9:00 AM"},{"id":"f2","label":"10:30 AM"},{"id":"f3","label":"1:30 PM"}]}],"note":"Free 30-minute consultation - no obligation","submitText":"Confirm consultation","submitValue":"I would like to book"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): heading above the scheduler. Defaults to 'Book your free consultation'. - 'subtitle' (string, optional): a short supporting line. ONLY shown when there is no attorney (omit it whenever 'attorneyName' is set). - 'attorneyName' (string, recommended): the attorney the visitor is booking with; drives the hero header. - 'attorneyTitle' (string, optional): the attorney's role/focus, e.g. 'Managing Partner - Personal Injury'. - 'attorneyPhoto' (string, optional): a full image URL (https://...) for the headshot; if omitted or not a URL, the attorney's initials are shown instead. - 'modes' (array, optional): the meeting types, rendered as a toggle. Each item MUST have 'id' (string) and 'label' (string) and SHOULD have 'icon' (one of 'in_person', 'phone', 'video'; any other value falls back to a calendar icon). Typical set is in person / phone / video. - 'days' (array, REQUIRED for real content): each item MUST have 'id' (string), 'label' (string, e.g. 'Mon') and a non-empty 'slots' array, and SHOULD have 'sublabel' (string, e.g. 'Sep 21'). A day with no slots is dropped; if NO day has slots the card shows a generic sample (test mode) — always include real days with slots. - 'days[].slots' (array): each slot MUST have 'id' (string) and 'label' (string, e.g. '9:00 AM') and MAY have 'disabled' (boolean) to show an unavailable time struck through. - 'note' (string, optional): a reassurance line under the picker. Defaults to 'Free 30-minute consultation - no obligation'. - 'submitText' (string, optional): the confirm button label; defaults to 'Confirm consultation'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the base intent sent back to the agent when the visitor confirms; the card appends the chosen meeting type, day and time. Defaults to 'I would like to book'. Offer only genuinely available appointment times. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
